title: The seventeenth child
what_we_know: This book gives seventeen throughout, as the family does, and states at the outset that only sixteen can be documented. Either a seventeenth child was born later and went unrecorded, or an infant died young and is counted by the family but was never counted by the newspaper.
what_we_dont: Whether a seventeenth child was born, and who.
evidence_needed: A record of the seventeenth child.
